summary.en: Space Invaders that breed: every wave descends from the last, and each generation gets smarter.
summary.zh: 会进化的太空侵略者：每一波敌人都是上一波「繁衍」出来的，越打越聪明。

description.en: Familiar shooter controls. Wipe out a whole wave and the next one spawns, its movement and firing quirks crossed and mutated by a genetic algorithm — so the difficulty climbs on its own.
description.zh: 经典射击操作，消灭整波敌人后进入下一代，敌人的移动/射击特征由遗传算法交叉变异产生，因此难度自动升级。

howto.en: Left/right arrows to move, space to fire.

tip.en: A strong differentiator — 'an evolutionary boss you can never truly finish' beats yet another shooter for talking points. Pure front-end, tiny footprint, and mobile-friendly out of the box.
tip.zh: 差异化卖点强（「永远打不完的进化 Boss」），比普通打飞机更有话题。纯前端小体积，移动端适配良好。
